steps.what: Open the landscape and interior drawings to be colored.
Prepare colored drawings for the client presentation.
Check the color still matches the design.

tasks.design: The drawings to be colored are opened from {DOCS}. The drafter prepares the colored drawings of the landscape and interior designs for the client. A filled legend is not the presentation. The drawing model in {OTHER} does not apply the color. Nothing is sent to the client from this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Presentation sheets were colored the night before, from a set that was not the latest design.
tasks.enabler_now: The current drawings can be the ones opened. The coloring is unchanged.
tasks.still_hard: A material color the design has not chosen, and a view the client will misread.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can see a neat color that depicts the wrong material.
tasks.altitude: The current sheets are open. The colored presentation is still drawn by the drafter. The client still receives it from a person.

reach.task: Present the design the colored sheet has to depict.
reach.learn: The sheet can be current. The coloring cannot.

evidence.claim: The current drawing can be opened for a presentation. It cannot prepare the colored sheet.

Producing the drawing stays with the drafter. A rule list does not pass a design. An engineer signs a code conclusion. For a new class 1 building, an independent kwaliteitsborger still tests against the building rules. This list does not replace that test.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural or civil drafter in a European practice. National building rules apply. A list does not issue a drawing.
Fields: Sheet id, produced by the presentation set. A set with no sheet id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the drafter finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the presentation set the practice already keeps. No new tool colors the sheet.
research_questions: Is the presentation set the current design?
What share of coloring is still done by hand?

already_counted.description: The drafter still prepares the colored drawings.
The drafter still checks the color.

incremental.description: The drafter adds a view the list missed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is opening the current sheets. It disappears when the set is stale and the drafter hunts the right view. The coloring time is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Calculate heat loss and the equipment.

steps.what: Calculate heat loss and gain from stored areas and coefficients.
Determine the required equipment specifications from that table.
Record the specification the drafter accepts.

tasks.design: Heat loss and gain are calculated for buildings and structures only where the area and the standard coefficient are both in {DOCS}. The drafter determines the required equipment specifications from that table, following the practice's procedure. A missing area stops the line. The figure does not select the equipment, and the engineer still owns the specification that is issued.
tasks.previous_blocker: Areas were measured off a print into a pad, and a coefficient from another climate was reused.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored areas and coefficients can be multiplied before the drafter looks at the equipment.
tasks.still_hard: A room the model has no area for, and a specification the arithmetic does not choose.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can see a correct loss on a room that needs a different system.
tasks.altitude: Known rooms can show a figure. The equipment specification stays with the drafter. Nothing is ordered.

reach.task: Own the equipment specification a heat-loss figure only feeds.
reach.learn: The arithmetic can be prepared. The specification is still judged here.

evidence.claim: Heat loss can be computed from an area and a coefficient already in the file. The equipment specification cannot.
A missing area stops the line. Selecting equipment is the drafter's judgement under the standard procedure, and the issued specification stays with the engineer.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural or civil drafter in a European practice. National building rules apply. A list does not issue a drawing.

Fields: Room id, area, and coefficient id, produced by the model and the procedure table. A room with no area is not calculated. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the drafter finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the areas and coefficients the practice already stores.
research_questions: What share of rooms have a stored area?
Which specifications are always referred to the engineer?

already_counted.description: The drafter still determines the equipment specifications.
The drafter still records the specification.

incremental.description: The drafter measures an area the model did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the heat figure where area and coefficient are already stored. It disappears when an area is missing and the drafter measures. The equipment judgement remains, so the net stays under the prior.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: A colored presentation is still drawn by the drafter. Heat loss can be computed when the areas and the coefficients are already in the file, and the equipment specification stays a judgement.
reach: Architects expect a colored landscape sheet to be drawn, not generated from a palette.
Mechanical engineers own the equipment specification a heat-loss figure only feeds.
skills_to_grow: Stop a heat-loss line when the area or the coefficient is missing.
Keep a colored presentation as a drawing for the client.
role.ambitious_version: A known room can show a heat-loss figure from stored areas, and the colored drawing for the client is still made by the drafter.
